Research and compile a list of Ugandan-born actors whose screen debut occurred in the late 1970s (approx. 1976–1979). For each candidate: (1) confirm birthplace (Uganda), (2) confirm screen debut year and title (film or television), (3) collect reliable evidence that they are noted for mastering several accents (interviews, profiles, reputable sources), and (4) list notable films they starred in up to Dec 31, 2023. Then, identify any of those films that were directed by someone who moved to Hollywood in the late 1980s and had two personal Academy Award (Oscars) nominations by Dec 31, 2023. Provide citations (links) for all biographical facts and nomination counts, and note any uncertainties (e.g., first credited vs. first on-screen appearance, accents claims, exact move dates).

Build a comprehensive list of actors and actresses who were born in Uganda (any nationality) and whose earliest on-screen credit (film or TV) occurred between 1976 and 1979 inclusive. For each candidate, do the following: (1) confirm birthplace and date (with at least one reputable source, e.g., Wikipedia + an independent source like BFI, AllMovie, news articles, or obituaries), (2) confirm earliest on-screen credit and year (with citations; note whether the role was credited or uncredited, film or TV), (3) collect reliable evidence that the actor is noted for mastering or using multiple accents across roles (e.g., interviews, reputable profiles, or press coverage; quote or summarize the phrasing and cite), and (4) list notable films they starred in (leading or prominent roles) up to Dec 31, 2023. Include links for all claims and note any uncertainties (e.g., discrepancy on debut year, birthplace ambiguity, or subjective claims about accent mastery). Ensure the search goes beyond a single category page: include Wikipedia, BFI, AllMovie, Variety/Hollywood Reporter interviews, national press, and other credible sources; include both male and female performers and British/other-nationality actors born in Uganda (e.g., expat births). Present results in a structured, itemized form suitable for cross-matching in the next step.

Identify Ugandan-born actors/actresses (any nationality) with earliest on-screen credits between 1976–1979 inclusive and documented evidence of mastering multiple accents across roles. Steps: (1) Build a list of Ugandan-born performers via Wikipedia, national press, and databases (BFI, AllMovie); include diaspora and expat births (e.g., Kampala, Masaka, Jinja, Entebbe). (2) For each candidate, verify birthplace and earliest screen credit year/title (film or TV; credited vs uncredited) with at least one independent source beyond Wikipedia. (3) Find reputable interviews/profiles explicitly noting accent mastery or accent versatility; quote or summarize and cite. (4) List notable films they starred in up to Dec 31, 2023. (5) From those films, cross-match directors who moved to Hollywood in the late 1980s and have exactly or at least two personal Academy Award nominations as of Dec 31, 2023 (validate via Academy records or credible sources). Return a structured report of all plausible candidates and films satisfying all criteria, and separately list near-misses where one or more criteria (accent mastery, late-70s debut, director conditions) fail, with uncertainties clearly flagged.
